ModMetaData.name: Smart Haul
ModMetaData.author: paralax034 (original: Mehni)
ModMetaData.description:
Smart Haul - Intelligent inventory hauling and auto-collection for RimWorld 1.6.
Pawns carry multiple items in their inventory per trip instead of one at a time. Automatically collects products from mining, harvesting, deconstructing, and crafting. Multiplayer compatible.
Features: • Multi-item hauling with priority sorting (perishables first) • Auto-collection after work (mining, harvest, butcher, deconstruct) • Configurable pickup radius and inventory thresholds • Full Multiplayer compatibility • Safe inventory management (never touches personal gear)
This is a complete rewrite/fork of "Pick Up and Haul" by Mehni, optimized for RimWorld 1.6 and multiplayer.
